us_esta.title: ESTA required (USA)
us_esta.body: Apply for your ESTA online before flying to the US. Approval is usually quick but can take up to 72h.

uk_eta.title: UK ETA required
uk_eta.body: You need an Electronic Travel Authorisation to enter the UK. Apply online before you travel.

schengen_etias.title: ETIAS (Europe)
schengen_etias.body: An ETIAS travel authorisation may be required for the Schengen area. Check the official site before booking.

canada_eta.title: Canada eTA required
canada_eta.body: Visa-exempt air travellers need an eTA to enter Canada. Apply online — it is usually approved within minutes.

australia_eta.title: Australia ETA required
australia_eta.body: An Electronic Travel Authority is required to visit Australia. Apply via the official app before departure.

india_evisa.title: India e-Visa
india_evisa.body: Apply for an India e-Visa online a few weeks before your trip.

brazil_visa.title: Brazil visa
brazil_visa.body: A visa may be required for Brazil depending on your nationality. Check processing times early.

china_visa.title: China visa
china_visa.body: Most travellers need a visa for mainland China. Apply well ahead — processing takes about a week.

passport_validity_6mo.title: Passport must be valid 6 months
passport_validity_6mo.body: Many destinations require your passport to be valid for at least 6 months beyond your stay.

passport_validity_3mo.title: Passport validity (Schengen)
passport_validity_3mo.body: Schengen countries require your passport to be valid for at least 3 months beyond your departure date.

schengen_90_180.title: Schengen 90/180 rule
schengen_90_180.body: Visa-exempt visitors can stay up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen area.

jp_visa_free_90.title: Japan visa-free stay
jp_visa_free_90.body: Many nationalities can visit Japan visa-free for up to 90 days.

yellow_fever_zone.title: Yellow fever vaccination
yellow_fever_zone.body: A yellow fever certificate may be required or recommended for this destination. Check with a travel clinic.

cash_10k_eu.title: Declare cash over €10,000
cash_10k_eu.body: You must declare cash of €10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU.

cash_10k_us.title: Declare cash over $10,000
cash_10k_us.body: You must declare currency of $10,000 or more when entering or leaving the US.

thailand_visa_free.title: Thailand visa-free stay
thailand_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can enter Thailand visa-free for tourism. Check the latest allowed duration.

travel_insurance_schengen.title: Travel insurance (Schengen)
travel_insurance_schengen.body: Travel medical insurance is recommended (and sometimes required) for the Schengen area.

vaccine_routine.title: Check routine vaccines
vaccine_routine.body: Make sure your routine vaccinations are up to date before traveling.

nz_nzeta.title: NZeTA required (New Zealand)
nz_nzeta.body: Request your NZeTA online before flying to New Zealand. Note the separate IVL tourist levy (~NZD100) is charged on top. Allow a few days.

korea_keta.title: K-ETA (South Korea)
korea_keta.body: K-ETA is currently optional for visa-waiver nationalities until 31 Dec 2026 (it still lets you skip the arrival card). Apply online a few days ahead if you want it.

vietnam_evisa.title: Vietnam e-Visa
vietnam_evisa.body: Apply for a Vietnam e-Visa online a few weeks before your trip — it now allows stays of up to 90 days.

indonesia_voa.title: Indonesia visa on arrival
indonesia_voa.body: Most visitors need a Visa on Arrival for Bali/Indonesia. Buy the e-VOA online beforehand to skip the airport queue.

turkey_evisa.title: Türkiye e-Visa
turkey_evisa.body: Some nationalities need an e-Visa for Türkiye. Apply online before you fly — it only takes a few minutes.

egypt_evisa.title: Egypt e-Visa
egypt_evisa.body: Apply for an Egypt e-Visa online before you travel. A single-entry tourist e-Visa is usually issued within a week.

morocco_entry.title: Morocco — visa-free entry
morocco_entry.body: Many nationalities can enter Morocco visa-free for up to 90 days. Make sure your passport is valid for at least 6 months.

uae_voa.title: UAE — entry on arrival
uae_voa.body: Most visitors get a free visa-on-arrival or visa-free entry to the UAE. Check the stay length allowed for your nationality.

kenya_eta.title: Kenya eTA required
kenya_eta.body: Most travellers to Kenya need an electronic travel authorization (eTA) before arrival; many African nationals are now exempt. Apply a few days ahead.

south_africa_entry.title: South Africa — visa-free entry
south_africa_entry.body: Many nationalities can visit South Africa visa-free for up to 90 days. Bring a passport with at least one blank page, valid 1 month past departure.

mexico_tourist.title: Mexico — tourist entry
mexico_tourist.body: Many nationalities can visit Mexico visa-free for up to 180 days. You receive a tourist permit (FMM) on arrival — keep it for departure.

argentina_visa_free.title: Argentina — visa-free entry
argentina_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can enter Argentina visa-free for up to 90 days. Check that your passport is valid for the whole stay.

schengen_visa_short_stay.title: Schengen short-stay visa
schengen_visa_short_stay.body: Your nationality may need a Schengen visa (type C) for trips up to 90 days. Apply at the consulate of your main destination several weeks ahead.

uk_standard_visitor.title: UK Standard Visitor visa
uk_standard_visitor.body: Your nationality may need a UK Standard Visitor visa. Apply online a few weeks before you travel — processing can take around 3 weeks.

singapore_visa_free.title: Singapore — arrival card
singapore_visa_free.body: Most visitors enter Singapore visa-free, but you must submit the free SG Arrival Card online within 3 days before you arrive.

malaysia_visa_free.title: Malaysia — digital arrival card
malaysia_visa_free.body: Many nationalities enter Malaysia visa-free for up to 90 days. Submit the free Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) before you travel.

philippines_visa_free.title: Philippines — visa-free entry
philippines_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit the Philippines visa-free for 30 days. Register your eTravel online before arrival.

sri_lanka_eta.title: Sri Lanka ETA
sri_lanka_eta.body: Apply for your Sri Lanka ETA online before you fly — it is now free for most nationalities. Approval is usually quick.

cambodia_evisa.title: Cambodia e-Visa
cambodia_evisa.body: Apply for a Cambodia e-Visa online a few days before your trip (visa on arrival is also available).

nepal_voa.title: Nepal visa on arrival
nepal_voa.body: Most visitors get a Nepal visa on arrival — fill the online form beforehand and bring USD plus a photo.

qatar_visa_free.title: Qatar — visa waiver
qatar_visa_free.body: Many nationalities get a free visa waiver on arrival in Qatar. Check the stay length allowed for your passport.

saudi_evisa.title: Saudi Arabia e-Visa
saudi_evisa.body: Apply for a Saudi tourist e-Visa online before you travel. (Hajj/Umrah uses a separate visa.)

oman_evisa.title: Oman — visa-free up to 14 days
oman_evisa.body: Most visitors get 14 days visa-free in Oman; you only need an e-Visa for longer stays. Apply online if staying longer.

peru_visa_free.title: Peru — visa-free entry
peru_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Peru visa-free. Keep your stamped entry slip for departure.

colombia_visa_free.title: Colombia — visa-free entry
colombia_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can enter Colombia visa-free for up to 90 days. Fill the Check-Mig form before each flight.

chile_visa_free.title: Chile — visa-free entry
chile_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Chile visa-free for up to 90 days. Keep your tourist card (PDI) for departure.

costa_rica_visa_free.title: Costa Rica — visa-free entry
costa_rica_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Costa Rica visa-free for up to 90 days. Bring proof of onward travel.

cuba_tourist_card.title: Cuba tourist card
cuba_tourist_card.body: Cuba requires a tourist card (tarjeta del turista) plus travel insurance. Buy the card before you fly.

tanzania_visa.title: Tanzania visa
tanzania_visa.body: Apply for a Tanzania e-Visa online before you travel (single-entry tourist visa).

ethiopia_evisa.title: Ethiopia e-Visa
ethiopia_evisa.body: Apply for an Ethiopia e-Visa online before you fly — it is the simplest way to enter.

us_b1b2_visa.title: US B1/B2 visitor visa
us_b1b2_visa.body: If your nationality is not in the Visa Waiver Program, apply for a US B1/B2 visa well ahead — interview wait times can be long.

dominican_republic_eticket.title: Dominican Republic — e-Ticket
dominican_republic_eticket.body: Fill the free Dominican Republic e-Ticket online before departure and arrival. The tourist card is included in most airfares.

jamaica_visa_free.title: Jamaica — visa-free entry
jamaica_visa_free.body: Many nationalities visit Jamaica visa-free. Complete the online immigration/customs form before you travel.

panama_visa_free.title: Panama — visa-free entry
panama_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Panama visa-free. Bring proof of onward travel and sufficient funds.

nigeria_visa.title: Nigeria visa
nigeria_visa.body: Nigeria requires a visa for most travelers — apply online ahead. A yellow fever certificate is also required.

ghana_visa.title: Ghana visa
ghana_visa.body: Ghana requires a visa for most travelers — apply ahead. A yellow fever certificate is required to enter.

senegal_visa_free.title: Senegal — visa-free entry
senegal_visa_free.body: Many nationalities visit Senegal visa-free for up to 90 days. A yellow fever vaccination is recommended.

myanmar_evisa.title: Myanmar e-Visa
myanmar_evisa.body: Apply for a Myanmar tourist e-Visa online before you travel.

bangladesh_voa.title: Bangladesh visa on arrival
bangladesh_voa.body: Many travelers can get a Bangladesh visa on arrival; check requirements and bring USD for the fee.

maldives_visa_free.title: Maldives — free visa on arrival
maldives_visa_free.body: All visitors get a free 30-day visa on arrival. Submit the IMUGA traveller declaration within 96h before arrival.

laos_evisa.title: Laos e-Visa
laos_evisa.body: Apply for a Laos e-Visa online before you travel (visa on arrival is also available).

mongolia_visa_free.title: Mongolia — visa-free entry
mongolia_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Mongolia visa-free for up to 30 days. Check the latest list for your passport.

ecuador_visa_free.title: Ecuador — visa-free entry
ecuador_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Ecuador visa-free for up to 90 days per year.

uruguay_visa_free.title: Uruguay — visa-free entry
uruguay_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Uruguay visa-free for up to 90 days.

ireland_visa_free.title: Ireland — visa-free entry
ireland_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Ireland visa-free (Ireland is not in the Schengen area — it is a separate entry).

georgia_visa_free.title: Georgia — visa-free entry
georgia_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can stay in Georgia visa-free for up to a year. Check the list for your passport.

jordan_visa.title: Jordan visa / Jordan Pass
jordan_visa.body: Most travelers need a Jordan visa. The Jordan Pass (bought before arrival) waives the visa fee and includes Petra — but only if you stay at least 2 nights.

bahrain_evisa.title: Bahrain e-Visa
bahrain_evisa.body: Apply for a Bahrain e-Visa online before you travel, or check if you are eligible for visa on arrival.

taiwan_visa_free.title: Taiwan — visa-free entry
taiwan_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can visit Taiwan visa-free for up to 90 days. Keep proof of onward travel.
